beforeShellExecution.command: d="${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; while [ ! -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" ]; then exec "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" hook pre-tool-use --agent cursor; fi; echo '{"permission":"allow"}'

sessionEnd.command: d="${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; while [ ! -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" ]; then exec "$d/node_modules/.bin/agent-env" hook session-end --agent cursor; fi; exit 0
